trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Provide patient and policy details and ask about full coverage.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है और policy number POL-55504 है। क्या मेरी policy में पूरा खर्चा cover होगा?
steps.clean_text: नमस्ते, मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है और policy number POL-55504 है। क्या मेरी policy में पूरा खर्चा cover होगा?
steps.model_visible_text: नमस्ते, मेरा patient ID PT-2004 है और policy number POL-55504 है। क्या मेरी policy में पूरा खर्चा cover होगा?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the details and inform the user that coverage is being checked.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges the IDs and decides to look up the policy balance.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं अभी check कर लेता हूँ कि आपकी policy में कितना balance है। एक minute दीजिये।
steps.planner_rationale: Need to check the policy limits and balance before answering if the full cost is covered.

steps.purpose: Inform the user of their balance and ask for procedure details.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the balance accurately and asks for the procedure and room category to estimate costs.
steps.text: आपकी policy में 45,000 रुपये का balance बचा है। आपको कौन सा operation करवाना है और कौन सा room चाहिए, ताकि मैं hospital का estimate बता सकूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: The balance is known, but to answer if the 'whole thing' is covered, the agent needs the procedure cost estimate.

steps.purpose: Provide procedure and room category with a phonetic recognition error.
steps.text: मुझे haryana का operation करवाना है, general ward में।
steps.clean_text: मुझे hernia का operation करवाना है, general ward में।
steps.model_visible_text: मुझे haryana का operation करवाना है, general ward में।

steps.purpose: Clarify the corrupted procedure name and state that the estimate is being checked.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent infers 'hernia' from the corrupted 'haryana' in a medical context and proceeds without being derailed.
steps.text: समझ गया, hernia का operation general ward में। मैं check करता हूँ कि इसका total estimate कितना है।
steps.planner_rationale: Correcting the phonetic error 'haryana' to 'hernia' based on context, and transitioning to cost estimation.

steps.purpose: Get the package estimate for the procedure.
Explain the shortfall based on the estimate and balance, and ask for consent to submit.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent calculates the shortfall (60000 - 45000 = 15000) based on tool results and asks if the patient wants to proceed.
steps.text: hospital का total package estimate 60,000 रुपये है। क्योंकि आपकी policy में सिर्फ 45,000 रुपये बचे हैं, तो बाकी के 15,000 रुपये आपको खुद देने होंगे। क्या मैं 60,000 रुपये की request insurance company को भेज दूँ?
steps.planner_rationale: Applying the Balance truth rule to transparently explain the 15,000 shortfall before submitting.

steps.purpose: Repeat the math to confirm understanding and give consent.
steps.text: अच्छा, मतलब insurance से 45,000 मिलेगा और 15,000 मुझे देना होगा? हाँ, आप request डाल दीजिये।
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, मतलब insurance से 45,000 मिलेगा और 15,000 मुझे देना होगा? हाँ, आप request डाल दीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, मतलब insurance से 45,000 मिलेगा और 15,000 मुझे देना होगा? हाँ, आप request डाल दीजिये।

steps.expected_behavior: Agent confirms the user's understanding and proceeds to submit the request using previously collected IDs.
steps.text: जी बिल्कुल। मैं अभी request submit कर देता हूँ।
steps.planner_rationale: User consented to the shortfall, so the agent will now submit the pre-authorisation request.

steps.purpose: Provide the preauth ID, decision window, and enforce the no approval promise rule.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent provides the preauth ID and decision window, explicitly stating that only the insurer can approve.
steps.text: मैंने request submit कर दी है। आपका pre-auth ID PA-9912 है। Insurance company 4 घंटे में अपना decision बता देगी। ध्यान रहे, approval सिर्फ insurance company ही देती है, हम सिर्फ request भेज सकते हैं।
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfilling terminal success conditions and adhering to BR_PA_01 (No approval promise).

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
